name: obelisk
description: Explicit memory infrastructure for coding agents — a queryable SQLite evidence layer over local coding-agent history, plus human-approved durable memory.

scripts.pretest: npm run build:core && npm run build:cli && npm run build --workspace @obelisk/dsh-obelisk-plugin
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p app/tsconfig.json && npm --prefix app run typecheck
